sourceConsumerReview: REST SettingsController GET/PUT subscription-settings, GraphQL Query/Mutation and gRPC SettingsGrpcService all call the legacy Core SettingsManager facade. The generated public JS SDK exposes it. Inspected portal settings-modal.js and onet-modal.js have no direct call. Main subscription popup uses separate authoritative ISubscriptionService. Wiring only REST would leave GraphQL/gRPC/aggregate fabricated defaults unresolved.
